decision: Depend directly on Ranvier.Css. Reuse its typed values, custom-property handles, declaration metadata and numeric token extraction. Do not expose replacement CSS types.
integrationNotes: Declaration.name/value/isImportant provide serialized property operations without a second public CSS model.
RuntimeApi.tryNumericValue provides literal numeric/unit metadata for values; expression eligibility must be validated separately.
Keep compile-time grammar constraints through generic entry points. Runtime unit compatibility still needs checks.

Ranvier.Css.Dom provides apply/read operations. Full declaration capture/restore replaces the complete style; animation cleanup needs property-scoped restoration to preserve unrelated concurrent writes.
verification: Semantic metadata inspection only; no animation implementation or native runtime test.
